name: L04-fix
delta:
SEED ROLES. The FIRST image is the `lettering-marker-italic` environment reference — preserve its authored place facts. The SECOND image is the channel's SCENE STYLE TILE — a register sample ONLY. It pins LINE WEIGHT, the outline colour (#241a12), the FLAT-CEL RENDER, and PALETTE SATURATION — match how strongly its flat fills are coloured and lay THIS frame's own hues, warm or cool, down at that same strength; a frame drained to neutral grey has failed to take the register. Take NOTHING else from it — not its content, not its objects, not its layout or camera, and NOT the place it depicts. This image is not a location and never appears in the frame you draw.

A suburban high-street electronics shop at dawn, its shutter half raised over a window stacked with beige computer cartons, the shutter's slats drawn as a small number of THICK bands at the same medium-thick rig outline weight as every other line in the frame, never thin parallel hairlines, a striped awning above, a parked hatchback at the kerb stage-right, the wet pavement empty end to end. Cool blue dawn with one warm amber shop-glow spilling out from under the shutter, blue-grey-amber palette, foreground depth from a cropped lamp post at the right edge. Propped on the pavement in that doorway light, a chalk sandwich board carrying the single chalked line '1983'.
